messages:
anya-ml: Quick intake — found model 'obsidian14b' on model-hub. README includes license snippet: ```LICENSE: NonCommercial-Research v0.9 — no commercial use, no derivatives allowed.``` Can we run quantization experiments or onboard to Dedicated? @leo-legal @sam-platform :eyes:

leo-legal: Thanks. From that snippet, 'no derivatives' likely forbids weight modifications (quantization). Need the full license file to confirm. If it's strictly NonCommercial, Hosted API is off the table. Dedicated might be possible only if the model author provides an explicit commercial license or a dual-license. Please upload the full license and model card link here. :mag:

marie-ml: We already pulled the weights into a short-lived test VM and started a smoke eval. If quantize -> int8, is that considered a derivative work in practice? Any internal precedent? @leo-legal

leo-legal: Short answer: modifications to the weights typically fall under "derivative" in many licenses. Quantization can be argued both ways legally; we treat it as a transformation that could create a derivative unless the license explicitly allows transformations/optimizations. We need explicit permission for quantization and for any commercial hosting.

sam-platform: Operational note: even if legal gives a green light for Dedicated, we need an export-control screening (model size / origin / training data). Also, do NOT add obsidian14b to the Hosted model catalog or model-registry until cleared. I'll add a catalog block.

anya-ml: Got it — I'll stop the smoke eval and snapshot the artifacts under a legal-hold bucket. Will also message the model author (question list below).

harper-compliance: Also check tokenizer/dataset attributions in the model card; third-party data licenses can introduce additional restrictions (e.g., CC-BY-NC). Use the intake checklist: https://intranet.redwood/legal/model-intake-checklist — run the dataset provenance step.

robot-deploy-bot: [automated] Scan complete: weights origin flagged as "external-unknown"; no provenance URL found in metadata. Intake ID: MDT-2026-0042.

anya-ml: Action items captured: 1) @leo-legal to draft a permission request template asking for (a) permission to quantize/optimize weights, (b) permission for commercial hosting or a dual-license, and (c) provenance for training data; 2) @anya-ml to terminate test VM and move artifacts to legal-hold; 3) @sam-platform to block catalog ingestion and add export-control tag; 4) @harper-compliance to run dataset provenance checks. Will update when author responds. :thumbsup:
